title: A Galaxy Far, Far Away
intro: [dramatic pause] A long time ago, in a living room far, far away... [excited] it's our space episode! Buckle up, cadets, twenty-six clues are coming in at LIGHT SPEED.

art.prompt: A grand starfield with a swirling purple and teal nebula, twin suns setting over a desert spaceport with domed adobe buildings, a sleek retro rocket and distant planets. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

categories.title: Directive: WALL-E
categories.intro: Our film category is WALL-E, the little trash-compacting robot with a big heart. [chuckles] Five clues, zero garbage. Well... mostly.

art.prompt: A sunset over towering stacks of compacted cube-shaped trash on an abandoned Earth city, a single green seedling growing in an old boot in the foreground. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: In WALL-E, the lonely trash robot falls head over treads for this sleek white probe droid
clues.reveal: The correct answer is EVE! [laughs] Her name stands for Extraterrestrial Vegetation Evaluator. Romantic, right?

clues.clue: WALL-E's only friend on Earth is a tough little pet that's one of these indestructible insects
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a cockroach. [sarcastic] Nothing says cute sidekick like the one creature that survives EVERYTHING.

clues.clue: The humans in WALL-E have spent 700 years aboard this giant luxury starliner
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Axiom. Floating chairs, smoothies in a cup, never walking anywhere... [sighs] honestly it sounds like a cruise I'd book.

clues.clue: WALL-E learns about love by watching a worn VHS tape of this 1969 movie musical
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hello, Dolly! WALL-E plays Put On Your Sunday Clothes on repeat. [chuckles] A robot with excellent taste.

clues.clue: This comedic actor played Buy n Large CEO Shelby Forthright, making him the first live-action star in a Pixar feature
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Fred Willard! [excited] Pixar's first live-action role ever. Stay the course, everybody... stay the course.

categories.title: A Galaxy Far, Far Away
categories.intro: [whispers] Use the Force... because this category is all about Star Wars. The Force is strong with this one, hopefully.

art.prompt: Twin suns setting over vast desert dunes with a lonely domed homestead, starships streaking across a dusky sky, epic space-opera mood. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Luke Skywalker's famous father is this black-masked Sith Lord
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Darth Vader! [laughs] Nooooo! Sorry, spoiler alert for a movie from 1980.

clues.clue: The adorable green foundling fans first called 'Baby Yoda' is actually named this
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Grogu! [excited] He was revealed by name in season two of The Mandalorian. Cutest thing in the galaxy, and he eats frog eggs like popcorn.

clues.clue: Chewbacca, Han Solo's furry co-pilot, belongs to this tall species from the planet Kashyyyk
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a Wookiee! [chuckles] Pro tip: let the Wookiee win at holochess. Trust me on this.

clues.clue: In A New Hope, Princess Leia's peaceful home planet is destroyed by the Death Star
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Alderaan. [sighs] Leia even gave up the location of a decoy base to try to save it. Tarkin did NOT keep his promise.

clues.clue: George Lucas sold Lucasfilm, and Star Wars with it, to Disney in this year
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2012, for about four billion dollars. [laughs] Mickey Mouse with a lightsaber. Best purchase ever.

categories.title: Alphabetize the Galaxy
categories.intro: Alphabetize the Galaxy! I give you four out-of-this-world names, you tell me which comes FIRST or LAST alphabetically. [mischievously] No humming the alphabet song... out loud.

art.prompt: Glowing holographic alphabet blocks floating in deep space among asteroids and stars, arranged in a neat row, playful sci-fi mood. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Which comes FIRST alphabetically: Yoda, Leia, Chewbacca, Rey?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Chewbacca! C beats L, R and Y. [laughs] And honestly, Chewie beats most things.

clues.clue: Which comes LAST alphabetically: Hoth, Endor, Naboo, Tatooine?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tatooine. Last in the alphabet, but first in sand. [sighs] Coarse, rough, irritating sand.

clues.clue: Which comes FIRST alphabetically: Stitch, WALL-E, EVE, Buzz Lightyear?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Buzz Lightyear! To the front of the line... and beyond!

clues.clue: Which comes LAST alphabetically: Mandalorian, Millennium Falcon, Mace Windu, Maz Kanata?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Millennium Falcon. All four start with M-A or M-I, and I comes after A. [chuckles] She may not look like much, but she's got it where it counts.

clues.clue: Which comes FIRST alphabetically: Kylo Ren, Kessel, Kashyyyk, Kenobi?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Kashyyyk! K-A beats K-E and K-Y. [laughs] Bonus points if you can spell it. Three Ys, people. THREE.

categories.title: Galaxy's Edge and Beyond
categories.intro: Our Disney Parks category is Galaxy's Edge and Beyond: space-age attractions from Batuu to Tomorrowland. [excited] Punch it!

art.prompt: A bustling alien marketplace at dusk with towering petrified stone spires, glowing lanterns, a parked weathered freighter starship and droids' workshops. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: This Magic Kingdom roller coaster sends riders racing through the dark of outer space
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Space Mountain! It opened in Magic Kingdom in 1975. [whispers] And yes, it's even scarier in the dark... which is the whole time.

media.prompt: A gleaming white ribbed cone-shaped futuristic building glowing at night under a starry sky, with soft blue lights and a sleek monorail track nearby. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: At Savi's Workshop in Galaxy's Edge, guests build their very own one of these glowing weapons
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a lightsaber! [excited] Your kyber crystal sets the color. Mine would be gold, obviously. Very sparkly.

clues.clue: On Smugglers Run, crews of six pilot, shoot and engineer aboard this famous ship
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Millennium Falcon! [laughs] Pilots, please be gentle. The engineers are the ones who get blamed when you crash.

clues.clue: Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge is set in Black Spire Outpost on this remote planet
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Batuu! A planet on the edge of Wild Space. Locals say Bright suns instead of good morning. Bright suns, everybody!

media.prompt: Tall jagged petrified tree-trunk stone spires towering over a sandstone alien village with domed buildings, string lights, and a dusky orange sky. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: DJ R-3X, spinning tunes at Oga's Cantina, used to be the pilot droid on this original Disney attraction
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Star Tours! [chuckles] Rex was a famously terrible pilot, so the cantina really is the best career move for everyone.

categories.title: To Infinity and Beyond
categories.intro: Our fan category is To Infinity and Beyond: space adventures from all over the Disney universe. [excited] Ready for launch? Three, two, one...

art.prompt: A child's bedroom ceiling painted with stars and planets, a toy rocket launching through a window into a real starry galaxy with ringed planets. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Finish Buzz Lightyear's famous catchphrase: 'To infinity and...'
clues.reveal: The correct answer is beyond! [laughs] Buzz, buddy, you're a toy. But we love the confidence.

clues.clue: This tree-like member of the Guardians of the Galaxy only ever says three words, his own name included
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Groot! I am Groot. [chuckles] Which, roughly translated, means: great answer, partner.

clues.clue: Disney's 2002 film Treasure Planet reimagines this Robert Louis Stevenson adventure novel in outer space
choices: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Treasure Island. Long John Silver is a cyborg, the ships have solar sails... [excited] it's pirates in SPACE, people!

clues.clue: In Lightyear, Buzz's robotic companion is a cat named this
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sox, voiced by Peter Sohn, who later directed Elemental. [whispers] Personally, I'd adopt Sox in a heartbeat.

clues.clue: Disney's first PG-rated film, this 1979 sci-fi tale follows the crew of the USS Cygnus near a cosmic void
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Black Hole! [dramatic pause] It's still one of the darkest, weirdest movies Disney ever made. Maximilian the robot, shudder.
